name: GeoJS
summary: Free, keyless, CORS-friendly IP geolocation returning country, city, coordinates, ASN and timezone.
description: GeoJS provides IP-to-location lookups for the caller or any specified IP, in JSON, JSONP, CSV or plain-text variants. Endpoints exist for country only, full geo, ASN, DNS PTR and a browser JS snippet. It is designed to be called directly from web pages (backendless GeoIP), and bulk lookup is supported via POST.

rate_limit.summary: No published hard limits; described as free for any use.

license.name: Free service; terms on the GeoJS site (underlying database provenance not documented here)

agent_notes: Omit the IP to geolocate the caller. Latitude and longitude are returned as strings, and accuracy is a radius in km. Expect country-level reliability rather than street-level.
caveats: IP-level accuracy only; city-level precision is not guaranteed.
Latitude and longitude are returned as strings.
Research also lists JSONP output, which is not in the schema format enum.
